output.review: Finally tried QT Vietnamese Sandwich after hearing about their famous banh mi and I'm so glad I made the trip! I went with the Lemongrass Tofu Hoagie - and wow, it was divine! The tofu had this perfect 'meat-like' texture I'd been looking for, and the fresh, crunchy vegetables (cilantro, pickled carrots, cucumber, jalapeno) made every bite amazing. The bread was super crispy on the outside but still soft inside, which I really appreciated. At under $5, this is such an incredible value - you really can't beat fresh, made-to-order Vietnamese sandwiches at this price. I added pork pate on recommendation from the friendly staff and it added such a great salty depth of flavor. My only tiny complaint is that there's virtually no seating - just a few counter seats - but honestly, this is really a takeout spot, and it's perfect for grabbing a sandwich to go. I totally get why this place has such a loyal following. The lemongrass tofu hoagie is definitely a must-try for any vegetarian or banh mi lover. I'll definitely be back!
